name: Leonidas of Alexandria
life: The Holy Martyr Leonidas of Alexandria (†202) was the father of the great Christian writer Origen. A man of steadfast faith, he was first stripped of all his property and then condemned to death under the persecution of Septimius Severus. His son Origen wrote to him in prison: 'Father, do not worry about us, and do not flee from martyrdom on our account.' Leonidas died for Christ, his witness bearing fruit in the life and writings of his son.
